summary: Consume accepted Core@d0d33e49 and Agent@5f6e8b1 durable semantic-review V3 authority in the real Main strict cold-start chain. Replace Main's custom prompt/direct KnowledgeDispositionReview construction with an opaque trusted-bootstrap Agent runtime, durably pin the independent public trust policy and signed attestation in the existing strict journal/checkpoint, verify/consume it before terminal closure/persistence/G3/CAS, and prove fresh-process recovery. No second key/reviewer/evidence/journal platform and no Test.
sourceRef: Original Plan completion bullets 7-10; Requirement Design §§3, 11.3, 11.6-11.8, 13.2, 17, 18.2, 18.6; accepted Core rootcause8 evt-20260727164237-0250/Core@d0d33e49; accepted Agent rootcause8 evt-20260727174820-0254/Agent@5f6e8b1; current Main@1c16269 direct StrictDispositionReviewRuntime authority gap
designIntent: 在 Alembic 现有 strict orchestration/journal/recovery 主链中消费 Agent 的 durable semantic-review runtime：受信进程 bootstrap 从既有 credential/config/provider/fact-authority 边界构造 opaque runtime，Main task/request 仅提交 SemanticDispositionReviewRequest；公开 trust policy 先独立 durable pin，V3 attestation 后持久化并由 Core production consumer 验证后才生成 KnowledgeDispositionReview。删除 strict 路径 Main 自定义 prompt/直接 receipt authority，保持 G1→admission→review/G2→persist→G3→G4→CAS 顺序，不创建第二 key store、reviewer、Evidence Ledger、journal 或编排器。

required.verify: One clean Alembic commit based exactly on 1c16269796f270ec95ab8a3b1ae9c129573b9ee6; consume local-source Core@d0d33e49 and Agent@5f6e8b1 through package exports; report parent/commit/tree/changed files. No Core/Agent/Plugin/Dashboard/Test/Wakeflow/vendor edits.

Run build:check/build, focused strict disposition/fact authority/journal/recovery/facade tests, full npm run check and npm test, repo/agent/core import/layer/ring/retired/naming/package gates and git diff --check. Report exact counts and distinguish any pre-existing failure.

Through the actual Main strict cold-start facade/orchestrator, prove every producer non-draft merge/duplicate and investigated-empty branch sends the exact Core SemanticDispositionReviewRequest to accepted Agent runtime, which loads the real current fact Evidence Ledger snapshot/witness/execution authority, calls the independent configured provider once per review with Core's exact compiled prompt, returns serialized V3 attestation, and Main verifies/consumes it with a separately durable-pinned policy before expression-set closure, persistence, G3/G4 or CAS. Persist policy hash, attestation hash and exact request/execution/load lineage in the existing journal/checkpoint; a fresh process must resume and verify without same-process object identity or reminting completed reviews.

Prove HTTP/job/task/request/journal payload cannot inject or replace signer/private key, trust policy, reviewer invoke adapter, evidence load adapter/config, model-load receipt, evaluator identity or prebuilt attestation. Ephemeral regenerated key, missing/alternate/tampered policy, attestation/request mismatch, wrong evidence session/blob/ref/witness/execution/load receipt, self-review, reused invocation/output, malformed/partial/tool-calling/provider-error/timeout/cancel/permission results, crash around policy-pin/attestation-persist, and the old direct KnowledgeDispositionReview/Main custom-prompt route all fail closed before terminal acceptance/persist/G3/CAS with no V1 fallback.

Main owns orchestration, existing journal/checkpoint persistence, independent public-policy pinning and Core verification/consumption. Agent owns signer custody abstraction, provider execution, evidence loading and attestation minting; Core owns deterministic contracts/verifier. Trusted process composition may provision the opaque Agent runtime from existing credential/config and strict fact authority, but per-task Main code cannot receive raw signer/invoke/load callbacks. Use an across-process stable configured Ed25519 key; never generate an ephemeral production key, persist a private key in the journal, or create a second key/reviewer/evidence/journal platform. If no real stable key-custody/config route exists, return that exact blocker instead of a fixture-only implementation.

Explain why Main@1c16269 is still insufficient: StrictDispositionReviewRuntime builds a Main-owned prompt, invokes generic AgentService, derives invocation/output identity locally and directly calls createKnowledgeDispositionReviewV1 without durable signer, authoritative load receipts, independently pinned policy or restart verification. Identify the exact replacement production entrypoints and show zero reachable strict callers of the retired authority path.

targetTasks.summary: Replace Main direct disposition-review authority with accepted Agent V3 attestations and durable policy pin/verification across the real strict chain and recovery.
